_default.name: Generic seller
_default.clause: Under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, a buyer is entitled to a remedy (replacement, repair or refund) for goods with a manufacturing defect, and can file a complaint with the National Consumer Helpline if the seller does not resolve it.

amazon.name: Amazon India
amazon.clause: Most electronics sold on Amazon India can be returned or replaced within the return window if they arrive damaged, defective or different from the description.

flipkart.name: Flipkart
flipkart.clause: Flipkart allows replacement or return within the product's return window when the item delivered is damaged, defective or not as described.

samsung.name: Samsung India
samsung.clause: Samsung smartphones and accessories carry a manufacturer's warranty against manufacturing defects, serviced through authorised Samsung service centres.

apple.name: Apple India
apple.clause: Apple's one-year limited warranty covers the product against defects in materials and workmanship from the original date of purchase.

boat.name: boAt
boat.clause: boAt products carry a manufacturer's warranty against manufacturing defects, claimable through boAt's support with the purchase invoice.
